::: {.callout-note appearance='simple' collapse=true}
## Source

Adapted from Kameron Decker Harris's Fall 2026 lecture notes "Logic 4, Proofs Intro, Direct Proof",
which he typeset from Scott Wehrwein's Spring 2025 handwritten lecture notes.
The rules of inference, the definition of "divides",
the observation that a definition's "if" means "if and only if",
and the template for a direct proof come from those notes;
the exercises are new.

The definitions of logical entailment, the integers, even and odd integers,
and proof are included from the
[mathematics prerequisites](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/) notes,
so they read the same in both places.
:::
